title: Data Modification (DML)
description: Inserting, updating, deleting, merging, and truncating data, plus SELECT INTO.
longDescription: This module covers the data manipulation language (DML) statements in SQL Server. You'll learn how to insert new rows, update existing data, delete rows, merge data from multiple sources, truncate tables, and use SELECT INTO to copy data into new tables.
whatYouLearn: Insert single and multiple rows into a table using INSERT
Copy data from other tables using INSERT INTO SELECT
Update existing rows with the UPDATE statement
Perform cross-table updates using UPDATE JOIN
Delete rows with the DELETE statement
Remove all rows efficiently with TRUNCATE TABLE
Synchronize data between tables using MERGE
Copy table structure and data using SELECT INTO
